description: Case converter + slugify — Split text= into words (handles camelCase, PascalCase, acronyms like XMLHttpRequest, snake/kebab/dot, digits, any script) and return camel, pascal, snake, constant, kebab, train, dot, path, flat, lower, upper, smart title case (small words, colons, keeps iPhone/NASA), sentence case, URL slug (accents stripped, Cyrillic/Greek transliterated, & -> and; sep=, max_len= cuts at a word boundary, unicode=true keeps non-Latin letters), ASCII transliteration, and NFC/NFD/NFKC/NFKD normalization, plus the detected input case. to= limits outputs (comma list); split_digits=true splits letters from digits. Offline, max 10,000 chars. Price: $0.001 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: text_case
